gloss: draft (of cold air); a cooling of relations

definitions.gloss: draft; cold air coming through a gap
definitions.explanation: Cold air that blows in through gaps around a door, window or wall.
Figuratively, a growing distance or chill in a relationship that was once close.

examples.japanese: {隙間風|すきまかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧。

examples.english: Drafts get into an old house in winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}って→貼る：10447_haru⟧、{隙間風|すきまかぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}いだ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: I put tape on the window to keep out the draft.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{隙間風|すきまかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
examples.english: A coolness arises between the two.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{十年|じゅうねん}、⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{隙間風|すきまかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}き→吹く：02445_fuku⟧{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Ten years into the marriage, a chill began to come between husband and wife.

examples.japanese: ⟦{些細|ささい}→些細：07160_sasai⟧な⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}かった→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{隙間風|すきまかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Because of a trivial misunderstanding, a coolness grew between two people who had been close.
